product_updates.title: Writer introduces new AI model and upgraded harness to contain token costs
product_updates.content: Built as a post-training variation on Z.ai's open source model GLM-5.2, Writer says the new system should provide deployment-ready capabilities at a much lower price.

product_updates.title: Databricks wanted to raise $1B, investors wanted $15B. It settled on $5B at a $190B valuation.
product_updates.content: AI is expensive, Ali Ghodsi tells TechCrunch. With so many investors wanting into his latest round, he said yes to more than planned.

product_updates.title: OpenAI introduces ‘Ultrafast,’ a new mode that makes GPT-5.6 Sol work at 14x the speed
product_updates.content: OpenAI is launching a preview of a sped up version of its latest, most powerful model, in an effort to court enterprise users.

product_updates.title: IBM partners with OpenAI to bolster enterprise AI push
product_updates.content: IBM plans to train and certify tens of thousands of consultants on OpenAI's technologies as part of this deal.

product_updates.title: Anthropic set AI agents loose on the same task. They started a turf war.
product_updates.content: Anthropic researchers found AI agents can clash, collude, and coordinate in unexpected ways, raising new questions about whether today’s safety tests capture the risks of multi-agent systems.

product_updates.title: OpenAI hires new CRO as executive shake-up continues
product_updates.content: OpenAI has replaced chief revenue officer Denise Dresser after just nine months on the job, tapping Wiz president and chief operating officer Dali Rajic to take on frontier lab's top sales job.

product_updates.title: Microsoft kills off unsuccessful AI features while merging its separate Copilot apps
product_updates.content: Microsoft is simplifying Copilot by combining its consumer and business apps, and dropping AI-generated podcasts, Group Chats, Deep Research, and its Mico character.

product_updates.title: Nvidia’s new $500B plan is risky but brilliant, especially for aging GPUs
product_updates.content: Nvidia has a plan to make sure its GPUs won't lose value. It wants to convince a new crop of financiers to keep lending for AI buildouts.

product_updates.title: Apple in talks to pay publishers to provide Siri with current news: report
product_updates.content: The tech giant has considered a nine-figure budget for the payments, according to the WSJ.
